{{No footnotes|date=May 2026}}{{Short description|Surface of general type, in mathematics}}
In mathematics, a '''Burniat surface''' is one of the  [[surfaces of general type]] introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Burniat|first=Pol|year=1966}}.

==Invariants==
The [[geometric genus]] and [[Irregularity of a surface|irregularity]] are both equal to 0. The [[Chern number]] <math>c_1^2</math> is either 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
